label: Remove all traits
summary: Removes every trait from the character.
details: Written as `clear_traits = yes`.

label: Empty variable list
summary: Empties a variable list, so it holds no items any more.
details: You write the name of the list. Vanilla uses it with lists such as neglect_reason, praise_reason and available_petitions.

label: Close all windows
summary: Closes all the game's open windows (views) on the screen.
details: Written as `close_all_views = yes`.

label: Close a window
summary: Closes one named window (view) of the game's interface.
details: Without `player` the window closes for every player who runs the effect. If the effect does not come from the interface but from synchronized game code, set `player`, or the window is affected for all players. A short form `close_view = <view name>` also exists. Vanilla mostly closes `decisions` and `royal_court`.

fields.name: view
fields.text: The window to close.
fields.values: a view name such as decisions or royal_court

fields.name: player
fields.text: The player whose window is closed. Left out, it closes for all players who run the effect.
fields.values: a character, such as root or a saved scope

label: Complete activity intent
summary: Marks the character's current intent in the activity they take part in as fulfilled.
details: Written as `yes`. It works on a character who is involved in an activity and has an intent there.

label: Complete great project
summary: Finishes a great project at once, as if it had been fully built.
details: The project's on_complete effects run, but no completion animation plays. The requirements (such as contributions) are not checked. Written inside the great project's scope as `complete_great_project = this`.

label: Complete great project with animation
summary: Finishes a great project at once, as if it had been fully built, and plays its completion animation.
details: The project's on_complete effects run too. The requirements (such as contributions) are not checked. Written inside the great project's scope as `complete_great_project_animated = this`. Compare complete_great_project, which skips the animations.

label: Complete task contract
summary: Completes a task contract, using the named task contract reward.
details: You write the name of a task contract reward. Vanilla mostly writes names such as failure_standard, success_standard and success_critical, and a few others.

label: Complete travel plan
summary: Ends a travel plan at once, with no further travelling.
details: The on_action `on_travel_plan_complete` runs. Written as `yes` or `no`; the input does not say what `no` does.

label: Build in domicile
summary: Constructs a building in the domicile.
details: The cost is ignored, but the normal construction time still applies. You write the key of the domicile building. Vanilla uses it for the episcopal palace levels.

label: Use up banish reasons
summary: Uses up all reasons the character has to banish the target.
details: Until the character gets a new reason, they cannot banish the target again. The character is the one who would banish; the target is the one who would be banished.

label: Use up divorce reasons
summary: Uses up all reasons the character has to divorce the target.
details: Until the character gets a new reason, they cannot divorce the target again. The character is the one who would divorce; the target is the other person.

label: Use up execute reasons
summary: Uses up all reasons the character has to execute the target.
details: Until the character gets a new reason, they cannot execute the target again. The character is the one who would execute; the target is the one who would be executed.

label: Use up imprison reasons
summary: Uses up all reasons the character has to imprison the target.
details: Until the character gets a new reason, they cannot imprison the target again. The character is the one who would imprison; the target is the one who would be imprisoned.

label: Use up one revoke reason
summary: Uses up one reason the character has to revoke a title from the target.
details: Only one reason is used, unlike the other consume effects, which use all of them. The character is the one who would revoke; the target is the one the title would be revoked from.

label: Use a saint relic charge
summary: Takes one charge away from the relics available for the target saint.
details: It fails if the target is not a saint or has no charges left. Vanilla uses it once, with a saint saved as relic_creator_saint.

label: Copy traditions
summary: Replaces all traditions of the culture with the traditions of the given culture.
details: The culture's old traditions are dropped, not merged. Vanilla uses it with a culture saved as scope:norse.

label: Copy artifact modifiers
summary: Copies the modifiers of the target artifact onto this artifact.
details: Existing modifiers are not removed, the copied ones are added to them.

label: Copy inheritable looks
summary: Gives the character the inheritable looks of the target character.
details: These are the inheritable genes in the DNA, the part of a look that children can inherit. The target is the source, the character is the one who changes.

label: Copy text from character
summary: Copies a piece of text for a given key from another character into the character.
details: Vanilla uses it once, with the key story_cycle_dog_name and root as the target.

fields.name: key
fields.text: The key of the text to copy.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character the text is copied from.

label: Copy title history
summary: Copies the history of another title onto this title.
details: The given title is the source. Vanilla uses it with titles written as `title:k_sicily`.

label: Copy traits
summary: Adds all traits of the target character to the character.
details: Traits the character may not have are skipped. Their existing traits stay.

label: Create accolade
summary: Creates an accolade for the character, with the given knight and accolade type.
details: If you give no name, the game makes one up. The game's documentation speaks of accolade types in the plural but shows only `primary`. The input shows no vanilla use.

fields.name: knight
fields.text: The knight the accolade is created with.

fields.name: primary
fields.text: The accolade's type.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The accolade's name.

label: Create adventurer title
summary: Creates a title for a landless adventurer, meant for the chosen holder.
details: The government is the adventurer one unless you give another. The name can be a localization key or a dynamic description. `pre` and `adj` use the name if left out.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The title's name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: holder
fields.text: The character who is meant to hold the title.

fields.name: government
fields.text: The government type of the new title.

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new title under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.

fields.name: article
fields.text: The article in front of the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: pre
fields.text: The text placed before the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: adj
fields.text: The adjective form of the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

label: Create alliance
summary: Makes an alliance between the character and the target.
details: The two allied-through characters are the ones the game checks to decide whether the alliance persists. The short form `create_alliance = <character>` uses the character and the target as those two.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character the alliance is made with.

fields.name: allied_through_owner
fields.text: The character on the scoped character's side who is checked for whether the alliance persists.

fields.name: allied_through_target
fields.text: The character on the target's side who is checked for whether the alliance persists.

label: Create artifact
summary: Creates a new artifact and puts it into the character's inventory.
details: The game uses the current scopes when it reads the artifact's visuals (common/artifacts/visuals). `durability` is the maximum if left out. `decaying` is yes by default. `generate_history` makes the game write a history entry when none is scripted. Vanilla always gives name, description, visuals, type and modifier, and mostly saves the artifact with `save_scope_as`.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The artifact's name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: description
fields.text: The artifact's description.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: type
fields.text: The inventory slot type, such as trinket.

fields.name: rarity
fields.text: How rare the artifact is, such as legendary.

fields.name: modifier
fields.text: The modifier applied to the character who wields the artifact.

fields.name: visuals
fields.text: How the artifact looks.

fields.name: template
fields.text: A ready-made base with triggers and modifiers.

fields.name: quality
fields.text: A number the AI uses to score the artifact.

fields.name: wealth
fields.text: A number the AI uses to score the artifact.

fields.name: durability
fields.text: The starting durability.

fields.name: max_durability
fields.text: Replaces the maximum durability the game defines.

fields.name: decaying
fields.text: Whether the artifact wears down with time.

fields.name: history
fields.text: A custom history entry, with a `type` such as created, given, stolen or reforged.

fields.name: generate_history
fields.text: Whether the game writes a history entry if none is scripted.

fields.name: creator
fields.text: The creator of the artifact.

fields.name: visuals_source
fields.text: Where coat of arms graphics come from. Only a few models use it, mostly banners.

fields.name: title_history
fields.text: A title whose history entries are added to the artifact's history.

fields.name: title_history_date
fields.text: The date from which the title's history is copied.

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new artifact under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.

label: Betroth
summary: Betroths the character to the target character.
details: At least one of the two must not be an adult yet.

label: Betroth matrilineally
summary: Betroths the character to the target character in a matrilineal way.
details: At least one of the two must not be an adult yet. The game's documentation does not explain what matrilineal changes in practice.

label: Create cadet branch
summary: Makes the character found a cadet branch (a new house) of the house they belong to.
details: The character must belong to a house and must not be its head. The game's documentation lists `spread_to_descendants` (default yes); going by its name it decides whether descendants join the new branch.

fields.name: name
fields.text: How the new house is named.
fields.values: a dynamic description, such as a name style

fields.name: prefix
fields.text: A name prefix such as dynnp_de. Vanilla uses it once; the game's documentation does not list it.

fields.name: coat_of_arms
fields.text: The coat of arms of the new house.

fields.name: spread_to_descendants
fields.text: Whether the character's descendants join the new house, going by its name.

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new house under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.

label: Create character
summary: Creates a new character.
details: Faith, culture and dynasty come from the template character, else the father, the mother, then the employer (the employer does not give the dynasty). Without an employer, and unless a parent is landed, the character becomes a pool character. Without `dynasty_house`, a new dynasty is generated unless you say otherwise. Vanilla mostly sets `location`, a `template` and `save_scope_as`.

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new character under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The character's name.

fields.name: age
fields.text: The age.

fields.name: gender
fields.text: The gender.
fields.values: male, female or a character to take it from

fields.name: gender_female_chance
fields.text: The chance in percent that the character is female.

fields.name: opposite_gender
fields.text: A character whose gender is the opposite of the new one.

fields.name: trait
fields.text: A trait the character gets.

fields.name: random_traits
fields.text: Whether random traits are added.

fields.name: random_traits_list
fields.text: Picks traits at random from those whose triggers are met. `count` says how many, default 1.

fields.name: health
fields.text: The health.

fields.name: fertility
fields.text: The fertility.

fields.name: mother
fields.text: The mother.

fields.name: father
fields.text: The father.

fields.name: real_father
fields.text: The biological father. Only set when different from the father.

fields.name: employer
fields.text: The court the character joins.

fields.name: location
fields.text: The pool province the character starts in. Cannot be combined with employer.

fields.name: template
fields.text: A character template to take values from.

fields.name: template_character
fields.text: A character to take faith, culture and more from.

fields.name: faith
fields.text: The faith.

fields.name: random_faith
fields.text: A faith picked at random among those whose triggers are met.

fields.name: random_faith_in_religion
fields.text: A random faith of the given religion.

fields.name: rite
fields.text: A rite the character gets instead of the faith's default rite, if it belongs to their faith.

fields.name: culture
fields.text: The culture.

fields.name: random_culture
fields.text: A culture picked at random among those whose triggers are met.

fields.name: random_culture_in_group
fields.text: A random culture of the given group.
fields.values: a culture group or a culture

fields.name: dynasty_house
fields.text: The house the character belongs to.

fields.name: dynasty
fields.text: What to do when no house is given.

fields.name: ethnicity
fields.text: How the look is chosen.
fields.values: culture, mother, father, parents or an ethnicity

fields.name: ethnicities
fields.text: Picks the ethnicity at random from this list, with triggers.

fields.name: after_creation
fields.text: Effects run once the character exists. The scope is the new character, the creating scope is PREV.

fields.name: martial / diplomacy / intrigue ...
fields.text: A skill value. Skills left out get a random value.

label: Create memory
summary: Gives the character a new memory of a given type, with the participants.
details: The new memory is saved as `scope:new_memory`. The duration is optional; vanilla sets it rarely (3 of 470 uses).

fields.name: type
fields.text: The kind of memory.

fields.name: participants
fields.text: The participants, each under a role name.

fields.name: duration
fields.text: How long the memory lasts.

label: Create clerical region
summary: Creates a clerical region with its capital in the province.
details: The new region takes the free counties of the capital province's de jure kingdom. Only counties reachable over land from the capital are used. Written inside the province scope; afterwards use the saved title, for instance `scope:new_title ?= { ... }`.

fields.name: domicile_type
fields.text: The domicile type of the region. Vanilla uses ecclesiastical_domicile.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The region's name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: adj
fields.text: The adjective form.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: pre
fields.text: The text placed before the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: article
fields.text: The article in front of the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new title under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.

label: Create confederation
summary: Creates a confederation and adds the character as a member.
details: The new confederation is saved as `scope:new_confederation`. If you give a leader house, that house leads it.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The confederation's name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: type
fields.text: The confederation type, such as confederation_type:house_bloc_ceremony.

fields.name: leader
fields.text: The house that leads the confederation.

label: Create divergent culture
summary: Creates a new culture that splits off from the character's culture.
details: The new culture keeps all pillars and traditions of its parent; adding or removing some is up to you. It is saved as `scope:new_culture`. Unlike the _with_side_effects versions, it does not charge the cost or convert people.

label: Diverge culture like in the game
summary: Splits a new culture off from the character's culture, as if the player had done it in the interface.
details: It charges the cost, converts people and changes things like the ethos. The new culture is not saved as a scope. See create_divergent_culture_with_side_effects_excluding_cost for the version without the cost.

label: Diverge culture, no cost
summary: Splits a new culture off from the character's culture as in the interface, but without charging the cost.
details: It still converts people and changes things like the ethos. The new culture is not saved as a scope.

label: Create domicile title
summary: Creates a title for a government type that uses a domicile, meant for the given holder.
details: Meant for modded government types. For the base game's governments, use the more specific effects such as create_nomad_title and give_noble_family_title. The tier is county unless you set it.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The title's name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: holder
fields.text: The character who is meant to hold the title.

fields.name: government
fields.text: The government type. It must have a domicile type.

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new title under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.

fields.name: tier
fields.text: The title's rank.
fields.values: county, duchy, kingdom, empire or hegemony

fields.name: article
fields.text: The article in front of the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: pre
fields.text: The text placed before the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: adj
fields.text: The adjective form.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

label: Create dynamic rite
summary: Creates a new rite inside the character's faith, with the character as its founder.
details: It starts from the founder's current rite and keeps its tenets and doctrines. The game then makes a name and icon from the final result. Overrides are applied before that. If a target divergence is set and the overrides do not reach it, random tenets and doctrines are added until they do.

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new rite under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.

fields.name: convert
fields.text: Whether the founder switches to the new rite.

fields.name: core_tenet_override_entry
fields.text: A tenet that replaces one of the tenets the founder likes least. Can be repeated up to the game's core tenet cap; extra entries are ignored with an error.

fields.name: doctrine_override_entry
fields.text: A doctrine. It replaces the doctrine of the same group, or is added if there is none. Can be repeated.

fields.name: target_divergence
fields.text: How far the new rite should differ from the main rite. The result can be a little more or less.

fields.name: include_unknown
fields.text: Whether tenets and doctrines unknown to the founder may be chosen.

fields.name: override_tenets_first
fields.text: Whether tenets are changed before doctrines.

label: Create dynamic title
summary: Creates a new title of a given rank with a name you choose.
details: The new title is saved as `scope:new_title`. `adj` uses the name if left out.

fields.name: tier
fields.text: The title's rank.
fields.values: duchy, kingdom, empire or hegemony in vanilla

fields.name: name
fields.text: The title's name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: adj
fields.text: The adjective form.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: pre
fields.text: The text placed before the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.name: article
fields.text: The article in front of the name.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

label: Create dynasty
summary: Creates a new dynasty and house with the character as its head.
details: The character must not be the head of the dynasty or house they leave. The game's documentation lists `spread_to_descendants` (default yes); going by its name it decides whether descendants join the new dynasty.

fields.name: prefix
fields.text: A name prefix.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The dynasty's name.
fields.values: a dynamic description or localization key such as dynn_Minamoto

fields.name: coat_of_arms
fields.text: The dynasty's coat of arms.

fields.name: spread_to_descendants
fields.text: Whether the character's descendants join the new dynasty, going by its name.

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new dynasty under this name, to use as scope:<name> afterwards.
